04 / DOCKSIDE CAPABILITY

What can the service call actually cover?

Tony’s Dockside is positioned around the issues boat owners actually experience: engines that will not start, intermittent alarms, charging problems, power loss and maintenance that needs to happen before the next day on the water.

ENGINE / SERVICE

Outboard service & repair

Routine maintenance, mechanical inspection, hard-start complaints and running-quality concerns.

ELECTRICAL / POWER

Starting & charging

Battery condition, connections, charging-system symptoms and related electrical troubleshooting.

DIAGNOSTICS / UPTIME

Find the cause first

Structured troubleshooting for warning alarms, intermittent faults, loss of power and preventive readiness.

07 / BEFORE YOU CALL

Fast answers before dispatch.

Do I need to haul the boat to a shop?

Not necessarily. When the work is appropriate for mobile service, Tony’s can come to the boat at the dock, lift or marina.

What information helps before the visit?

Boat and engine details, dock location, symptoms, warning messages and recent service history help establish the first diagnostic path.

Is mobile service only for breakdowns?

No. Routine maintenance, readiness checks and preventive service are an important part of reducing avoidable downtime.

What areas are covered?

Marco Island is the primary service area, with Goodland and Isles of Capri represented as nearby coverage zones.
